author: bshastry
content:
Pre-reqs: Attacker is validator index zero in collusion with first post Gloas proposer.

Attack: The attacker embeds a payload attestation for slot S-1 (last Fulu slot) targeting the last Fulu block. This is accepted by Prysm but rejected by other CL clients resulting in a split

Root cause: Prysm lacks spec guard forbidding a pre-Gloas  PTC lookup, so it interprets  the upgrade_to_gloas padding of all zeroes as a real committee. Since attacker controls validator zero signing key, they convince Prysm this is a real PTC vote
